record.question: Choose the option which is closest in meaning to compendious.
record.explanation: Answer A: comprehensive. “Compendious” means brief but comprehensive; comprehensive is the closest listed choice. Independent check: “Compendious” means concise while covering much information; “comprehensive” is closest among the options. Reference: https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/compendious.
